[b][size=4]DESCRIPTION[/size][/b]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
Replaces the ambient audio for each mine shaft biome with more subtle and less harsh sound.
Default is a subtle wind bed. Both the ice and lava floors have variations suitable for their environment.

The "frozen" floors have have a subtle treble "drone" effect with eerie convolver reverb.
The "lava" floors have a subtle bass "drone" effect and low passed "lava" bubbles similar to vanilla.


[center][youtube]SF_OVCGMsGw[/youtube]
[size=1]⚠️ Try listening with headphones...![/size][/center]

[b][size=4]BOTTOM TEXT[/size][/b]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
The vanilla cave sound is pretty much [url=https://youtu.be/RpSxNptRLBQ]a loud, click-y, low quality white noise loop[/url] in vanilla.
It hovers around the 500Hz - 1.5khz range. This gets in the way of combat sounds and effects.

This one is actually a bit lazy – it was for my personal game setup.
In a future update, I will mess around with the start and end points.

I would love to clean up the "cavedrip" sound with [url=https://skse.silverlock.org/]Content Patcher[/url], but there are currently issues when doing so.
When you replace certain sound effects, it breaks resampling and velocity (sounds no longer change pitch or volume).
